title: kitfox-config deployment profile
description: Validates platform/deployment-profiles/{configType}.yaml — named compute base layers selected by configType (§2.2, Story A.7). Deployment shape, not feature toggles.

defaults.description: Default compute envelope applied to every module (§2.2).

modules.description: Full per-module Helm values owned by this profile (D1=B, ADR-0009). Keyed by module name; permissive value shape to accept the folio-helm-v2 values structure. Credential-free by convention: secrets are k8s existingSecret references, never plaintext.
